name: input-otp-02
description: 6-digit OTP input with separators dividing field groups.

files.content:
import {
  InputOTP,
  InputOTPGroup,
  InputOTPSeparator,
  InputOTPSlot,
} from "@workspace/ui/components/input-otp"

export function InputOTPWithSeparator() {
  return (
    <InputOTP maxLength={6}>
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
      <InputOTPSeparator />
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
      <InputOTPSeparator />
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
    </InputOTP>
  )
}
